posts.name: Notion Developer Platform
posts.tagline: Build on Notion, not just inside it
posts.description: Notion Developer Platform lets teams build on Notion with CLI, Workers, database syncs, agent tools, webhook triggers, MCP, and External Agents APIs.

comments.body: Hi everyone! Notion used to be a place to work in. Now it's a place to build on.
Why not focus on fixing the editor and the slugginess first?! API Ratelimits is 3/s and expiring S3 Media URLs are game over.

posts.name: Notion 3.4
posts.tagline: New dashboards, connectors, sidebar & smarter AI agents
posts.description: Notion now generates images, builds dashboards, and presents your docs without leaving the workspace.

comments.body: New dashboard view turns scattered databases into clean KPI and metrics hubs without messy linked views.
